title: Unbiased Recommender Systems with Implicit Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2608.16704v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recommender systems typically rely on implicit feedback (e.g., clicks) to infer user preferences. However, such data is inherently prone to various biases, including position bias and popularity bias. Position bias occurs when higher-ranked items receive more interactions regardless of true relevance. Popularity bias reinforces frequent exposure of popular items while under-recommending relevant, yet less popular ones. Directly learning from such data fails to capture true user preferences, leading to suboptimal recommendations. This research focuses on mitigating position bias and popularity bias in recommender systems. Specifically, I address position bias in learning-to-rank (LTR) systems and popularity bias in collaborative filtering (CF) models and social recommender systems based on graph neural networks. translated_title: 无偏推荐系统与隐式反馈
translated_abstract: 推荐系统通常依赖隐式反馈（例如点击）来推断用户偏好。然而，此类数据本质上容易受到各种偏差的影响，包括位置偏差和流行度偏差。位置偏差是指排名较高的项目获得更多交互，无论其真实相关性如何。流行度偏差则强化了流行项目的频繁曝光，同时低估了相关但不太流行的项目。直接从此类数据中学习无法捕捉真实的用户偏好，导致推荐效果欠佳。本研究专注于缓解推荐系统中的位置偏差和流行度偏差。具体而言，我针对学习排序（LTR）系统中的位置偏差以及协同过滤（CF）模型和基于图神经网络的社会推荐系统中的流行度偏差进行了研究。我的工作开发了方法，以克服现有缓解位置偏差和流行度偏差方法的局限性。
tldr: 本研究提出新方法以克服现有技术在推荐系统中缓解位置偏差和流行度偏差的局限，从而更准确地捕捉真实用户偏好。
en_tdlr: This research proposes novel methods to overcome limitations of existing techniques for mitigating position and popularity biases in recommender systems, thereby capturing true user preferences more accurately.
